sourceCopy.name: Poker Odds Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Poker Odds Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Estimate Texas Hold’em win, tie and equity odds free. Run exact river odds or seeded local simulations; no account or uploads.
sourceCopy.intro: Enter your two hole cards, any community cards and the number of opponents. A complete river board uses exact enumeration against one opponent; other situations use reproducible simulations in this browser.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How are Texas Hold’em odds calculated?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: The calculator removes your cards and the visible board from a standard 52-card deck, then compares the best five-card poker hand each player can make. A complete board with one opponent checks every possible two-card hand. Other cases use a seeded Monte Carlo sample, so the same inputs and seed give the same estimate. Equity includes your share of split pots.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Card validation and all calculations run locally in this browser. No account, betting service, network lookup or saved hand history is used.
howTo: Enter two hole cards, such as As Kd. Use s for spades, h for hearts, d for diamonds and c for clubs.
Enter zero to five visible community cards, choose 1–8 opponents and set the simulation count and seed.
Run the estimate. Wins, ties and losses are separate outcomes; equity also counts your fraction of a split pot.

fields.heroHint: Example: As Kd. Rank then suit; use 10 or T for ten.
fields.boardHint: Enter 0–5 known cards, separated by spaces or commas.
fields.accuracyNote: Educational probability estimate only, not gambling or financial advice. One opponent on a complete five-card board is enumerated exactly (990 possible hands). Other cases use a seeded local simulation. Results do not predict a real hand or guarantee a win.

messages.cardFormat: Enter cards as rank plus suit, such as As Kd 10h.
messages.tooManyBoardCards: Enter no more than five community cards.
messages.duplicateCards: A card cannot appear more than once.
messages.opponentsRange: Choose between one and eight opponents.
messages.seedRange: Enter a whole-number seed from 1 to 4,294,967,295.
messages.notEnoughCards: There are not enough cards for that scenario.

additionalFaqs.question: What does poker equity mean?
additionalFaqs.answer: Equity is the estimated share of the pot: a win counts as one full share, and a tie counts as an equal fraction for each tied player. It is not the same as win percentage.

additionalFaqs.question: When are poker odds exact?
additionalFaqs.answer: With all five community cards visible and one opponent, the tool checks every two-card opponent hand not already visible. Other situations use a seeded Monte Carlo estimate and can vary from the real outcome.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I use this for betting advice?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It only compares card combinations under standard Texas Hold’em rules. It does not model betting, opponent behavior, rake, tournament strategy or future decisions.
